verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted runtime that claims voice support ([localai-docs-26]) and a real-time 'speech in … speech out over WebRTC' pipeline fast enough for conversation ([localai-docs-30]), running on local hardware with a first-class CPU path ([localai-docs-27], [localai-gh-1]). That implies on-device, real-time speech input, but the pack never explicitly documents transcription or a dictation workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit speech-to-text/transcription endpoint or model, a dictation-style UX producing text output, documented streaming-transcription latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
